Turn the boot inward enough that the toe projects LEFT of the ankle center, directed lower-left and aligned with the knee/ankle in the southwest travel plane. Keep its current leg extension, bent knee, lifted height and early approach-to-ground phase, with the boot still lifted; do not copy IMAGE 2's grounded/near-ground pose. Keep the other folded leg unchanged. Maintain anatomically coherent ankle, calf-to-boot junction, boot gold bands, bow, crescent emblem and foreshortening.
LOCK all other artwork exactly to IMAGE 1: face, lavender bob and cowlick, left-temple moon ornament, whole head/body position and scale, leaning torso, scarf, clothes, belt, turquoise beads, two arms, exactly two hands each holding one existing crescent dagger. Keep their silhouette positions. No zoom, recentering, mirroring, whole-character rotation or changes to the animation phase. Preserve the original entire square canvas, transparent margins and camera. One complete high-resolution square single sprite, preferably1254x1254 or at least1024x1024, true transparent RGBA, no floor/shadow/text/UI/extra effects. Match the clean rounded high-quality Q-style hand painting, only change the incorrect boot heading.
